style.styleTitle: Homcom 5ft Artificial Christmas Tree with 1524 Tips
style.toneOfVoice: Holiday setup can feel rushed, especially with pets or little ones nearby. The HOMCOM 5ft artificial Christmas tree eases that stress with auto-drop hinged tips that open more quickly. Crafted with 1524 dense PE and PVC tips, it delivers a full, realistic look. Flame-retardant materials add peace of mind during busy family moments, while a solid pine wood base brings a natural texture to your holiday decor. It helps your home feel festive, calm and ready for seasonal celebrations. . Classic Christmas tree design features a full-bodied profile; . Crafted with realistic PE and dense PVC leaves for long-lasting natural beauty; . Hinged tips drop automatically, making shaping quicker than normal trees; . Sectional trunks make storage compact once festivities end; . Flame-retardant tips help slow accidental fire spread for safer celebrations; . A solid pine wood base delivers robust stability and adds an elevated, textured natural look; . Versatile seasonal accent infuses an authentic forest touch and a vibrant holiday atmosphere into any indoor layout; . Colour: Green; . Material: PE, PVC, Pine Wood; . Overall Dimensions: F92 x 150H cm; . Base Dimensions: F28 x 15H cm; . Tip Count: 1524; . Item Label: 83C-293V00GN; . Shaping Note: Approx. 25-45 minutes of manual branch shaping recommended to achieve maximum natural fullness.
